question: Will the 12-month change in the U.S. PCE price index (BEA, seasonally adjusted; computed from the index) for November 2025 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2025-11-14) be above 2.69%, its value for August 2025?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2025-10-15 (August 2025), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
